match.selection_rule: exact block count; nearest parameters over d=16*j >= 32, FFN=8*j in [2d,6d]; ties prefer FFN=4d
match.parameter_scope: main blocks and final RMSNorm; no embedding, task head or artificial unused weights

observations.prompt_output_ready_definition: first completed call whose returned logical window covers last prompt injection plus full graph-depth delay; conservative terminal-path boundary, not memory causal attribution or language-model TTFT
observations.stable_decode_rule: omit first incremental call; no stable sample when fewer than two decode calls
observations.consumer: materialize backbone readout; synchronize every owner; release each output; no concatenation, task head, checksum reduction or D2H return
observations.timing_boundary: resident-input first call through final drain/readout/output release/context exit and all-owner synchronization; phase intervals include Python scheduling since prior ready boundary
observations.availability_source: separate full-schedule diagnostic at identical parameters/input/precision/execution policy; not a timed support capture

request_boundary: zero state per diagnostic/warmup/sample; real KV continuation within each request
timing_scope: same run_request as A-D; warm resident input; excludes construction, hashing, transfer and diagnostics; no cold measurement

initial_parameters.scope: dense initial named Parameters before ownership placement; shape/name/raw contiguous bytes

diagnostics.retention: one output window at a time; only hashes/scalars retained; separate from normal timing

execution.hooks: ordinary Python method/module hooks with locked counters; no thread-local dispatch mode
